reviews.title: Pass
reviews.text: App was better before the subscription-ized it. Was satisfied with it when it was a one time purchase. Now it asks for a review every five minutes and subscription upgrade.

reviews.title: What??
reviews.text: I purchased this app years ago with a one off payment that was meant to allow me to use it indefinitely but haven’t used it for a while. Just tried to use it again as went back to the gym again and it’s as if I never paid for it!!! Looks like they changed their subscription model and now want way more money than before so they stopped the acces to anyone like myself who had already paid!! Avoid!!

reviews.title: A paid membership?!
reviews.text: After years of using this app, they put half if not all the features behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Stay away from greedy developers, they are asking a lot of money per month for what I have already paid for years ago. It was a basic app and it was good. Now its useless :/

reviews.title: Need to pay subscription to make new workouts
reviews.text: I have used this application for over 6 years. I am sure I paid for it with a one time fee back then. I have created lots of workouts over the years but now I find I cannot create any new workouts without subscription. This is complete BS. I used to recommend this application to everyone and not I would tell people to look at other apps. Good job screwing your long term customers.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I got this app back in 2013 and paid full price for full version, was save in my apps and now decide to download it again, surprised I need to pay again have to workouts, it is disappointing they don’t respected previous users.

reviews.title: $15 a month?
reviews.text: Bought this app for $15 years ago and now they want to charge $15 a month? I tried restoring it but it said nothing to restore. I  should be grandfathered in!!!!!

reviews.title: Disappointing previous update / new paywall resulted in data loss
reviews.text:
Update a year or two ago deleted 11 years of workout history and saved data. 
And afterwards asking for a subscription to unlock content. For the app I purchased. 

I emailed customer services at the time and the paywall appeared- never heard back, but some of app unlocked subsequently. 
Disappointing. 
Might be worth looking into alternatives.

Now being asking for a review again. Moved from 1->2 stars as a result. 

Possibly recommended, but limited access to features (without payment).

reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: I paid for this app years ago and now it wants me to pay again for a subscription so I can get back what I paid for in the first place. Customer beware

reviews.title: Long time customer - everything is behind a paywall now
reviews.text: I bought this app a long time ago and sad to see all of the workouts that I used to have included for free now behind a paywall. My purchase from several years ago amounted to nothing which is a shame as I used to really enjoy using the app.

reviews.title: They changed it up
reviews.text: I outright purchased this app years ago. I had full access to everything and as many workout routines as I wanted to make. Then one day they changed it up and all my workouts and data was gone. They required for me to pay a new recurring subscription because that’s what all the other apps were doing now. It was shady and Apple should not have allowed them to charged this on people who already outright purchased the app. Not sure if they will decide to change again in the future. USER BEWARE.

reviews.title: Paid App AND Subscription?!
reviews.text: I paid for this app and am now being asked to subscribe for the features I paid for! Who do I contact for a refund of my previous payment?

reviews.title: Ripoff
reviews.text: Videos for exercises don’t work.  Charged a year before I could preview app.  Communicated this shortly after purchase—-crickets

reviews.title: Scamming Early Users
reviews.text: Early adopters punished for purchasing and supporting the app by having everything behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Vidéo issues
reviews.text: It has been 2/3 years the the videos don’t work anymore.

reviews.title: Videos
reviews.text: No videos to show how workout is done. If there is then it never loads.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I paid for this long ago when subscription wasn’t a thing. Now they added subscription and i have to pay again bait and switch

reviews.title: Keeps asking me to sign up
reviews.text: Bought ages ago with one off payment for full use. Disappointed!

reviews.title: Crashes all the time
reviews.text:
I used this for a long time but the app continues to crash after using for just a short period of time specifically when I would look at my records and when scrolling for just a short time, it crashes every time 

Was a decent app but needs improvement for sure

reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text: Bought this app a few years ago, at that time they had an option of £99.99 one off payment. Now the plans have changed to monthly/Yearly I no longer have the access. Emailed with no response several times. Looks like I will be deleting! Complete con.

reviews.title: Thanks for changing the package
reviews.text:
I purchased this app some years ago. I paid for it some small amount (1.99 or 2.99, do not remember). Now I decided to use it again and what I see - I have no access to what I purchased. Instead I have to pay £50 a year to get access to some AI busted buzz wording workout. 
I would like my money back please, this app is not usable anymore

reviews.title: Early adopters pay 2 prices
reviews.text: Bought the app years ago when they didn’t have subscription model. Now all of a sudden videos of exercises and other options are behind paywall. Thanks for punishing those who were early supporters of your app.

reviews.title: Horrible! Do not purchase!
reviews.text: I thought this app would be amazing all the things it promised it could do. I was so wrong! Get the videos to play on iPhones!! It’s not rocket science. I would give it no stars if I could. I’d give it a 5 Star Review if it does what it promised. Ugh! I should have read the reviews first. That’s on me though!

reviews.title: Restricted features despite having purchased.
reviews.text: I was an early adopter of this app, having purchased the full version years ago. The app has fundamentally not changed since it launched but what has changed is that many of the features I *paid* for are now locked behind an additional subscription fee. Shame on these developers. The useless “AI” features aren’t worth even a fraction of what they’re charging.

reviews.title: Don’t pay for it
reviews.text: Worse app ever. Paid the $50 for the entire year and videos are not shown as before when I started using this app 7 years ago. Needed to rewatch a few of them and thought by paying the $50 would open them and nah. Don’t make the purchase when you can see some stuff for free what you see paying for it.

reviews.title: Did not make any purchase,Please cancel my subscription ASAP THANKS
reviews.text: Did not make any purchase,Please cancel my subscription ASAP THANKS

reviews.title: Pay again? No thanks
reviews.text:
Too many apps sell you a lifetime and a few years later they want you to pay again. No thanks   Apple should stop these scammers. Had happened to
Me Several Times.  With other apps. Enough is enough bubye
